name: Tasmania — Northern / North-West
summary: The single best public dataset in Australia for potato economics: itemised Nov 2020 budgets across fresh, processing and seed.

name: Tasmania — Southern / Midlands
summary: Itemised Nov 2020 Low Rainfall budget models the Midlands district.

name: Victoria — Ballarat / Central
summary: No region-specific potato economics exist in the public domain. Victoria's own water-economics study excluded potatoes from its gross margin table entirely.

name: Victoria — Gippsland / Thorpdale
productionShare: Victoria's most potato-intensive region by area share
summary: No yield, price or cost data of any kind. Thorpdale is a certified seed district; West Gippsland is Victoria's #1 potato catchment.

name: Victoria — Mallee
summary: No yield, price or cost data of any kind.

name: South Australia — Northern Adelaide Plains (Virginia)
productionShare: 22.5% of Adelaide Plains gross ag. value
summary: Region-specific yield and water use exist; costs are only available as a 2005 state aggregate.

name: South Australia — Riverland / Mallee
summary: Region-specific yield and water use exist; costs are only available as a 2005 state aggregate.

name: South Australia — Limestone Coast (South East)
summary: Region-specific yield and water use exist; costs are only available as a 2005 state aggregate.

name: NSW — Riverina
summary: Three fully itemised 2013 NSW DPI budgets (2012 prices) — the second-best public dataset in Australia.

name: NSW — Central / Southern Tablelands
summary: No separate budget was ever published. Publisher states Tablelands yields run ~20% above Riverina — an approximation, not an observation.

name: Western Australia — Manjimup / Pemberton
summary: District-specific water use is directly measured; yield and gross margin are 2005-2013 state-level estimates.

name: Western Australia — Perth / Myalup
summary: District-specific water use is directly measured; a 2013 modelled gross margin exists for Medina/Dandaragan.

name: Queensland — Atherton Tablelands
productionShare: 60-67% of Far North Qld vegetable area/value
summary: One of the only region-labelled gross margins outside Tas/NSW — but it dates from 1998.

name: Queensland — Lockyer Valley
summary: Region-labelled 1998 gross margin; too old for current decisions.
